query: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q2 2026 quarterly results Amazon
normalized: 2026 amazon aws income operating q2 quarterly results revenue segment

output.content:
AWS generated **$42.232 billion of net sales (segment revenue)** in Amazon’s Q2 2026, the three months ended June 30, 2026, up 37% from $30.873 billion in Q2 2025. [[1]] 

AWS reported **$16.621 billion of operating income** in Q2 2026, versus $10.160 billion a year earlier; this equates to an operating margin of approximately **39.4%** of AWS revenue. [[2]] [[1]]

sources.title: Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results
